BiblicalUsage: Peder is the fat, the suet laid in order with the head upon the wood of the altar. The priests arranged the parts of the burnt offering — head and fat together — upon the fire.
TheologicalSignificance: What I believe is that God claims the best portion for Himself: the fat was His by His own law, and the offering was not complete until it was laid on the altar.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
